title: Ohm's law and its limitations
notes: **Scope.** Ohm's law and its limitations — Current Electricity, Physics (class-12-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: ohm's law, its limitations · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Ohm's law: V = IR; R = ρL/A (resistivity ρ depends on material).
**Fact.** Series: R = ΣR; same I, voltages add. Parallel: 1/R = Σ1/R; same V, currents add.
**Fact.** Power P = VI = I²R = V²/R; internal resistance makes terminal V = E − Ir.
**Its limitations.** one-line definition + one-line exam use.
